ACME-SA-2099-01: Remote code execution in AcmeDocs template engine (CVE-2099-12345)

AcmeDocs versions 4.0.0 through 4.2.3 are affected by CVE-2099-12345. Versions before 4.0.0 and version 4.2.4 and later are not affected.

Description

The vulnerability is caused by the template renderer evaluating expressions found in the X-Template-Hint request header without sanitizing them. An unauthenticated attacker with network access to an exposed AcmeDocs server can execute arbitrary code.

Prerequisites

The server must have the optional "preview" feature enabled, which is disabled by default in AcmeDocs 4.2.x but enabled by default in 4.0.x and 4.1.x.

Remediation

Upgrade to AcmeDocs 4.2.4 or later. As a workaround, disable the preview feature by setting preview.enabled=false in acme.conf and restart the service.
